title: OpenStax: expand ½(x + 2)^2 − 3 and check a table
stem_student: A graph looks like y = x^2 moved left 2 and down 3, then stretched by one-half: g(x) = (1/2)(x + 2)^2 − 3. Expand this to the ax^2 + bx + c form. Check a few points in a table to see that both writings give the same outputs.
stem_teacher: Figure 7 expand path only from the same catalogue record as the inspection reading. Page typesetting may show the half as 12 in places.
